title: P27: MAX_URL_LEN 8000 (INVENTED, NOT FROM SPEC)
description: INVENTED, NOT FROM SPEC. protocol-06 sets no URL length limit. mimi-protocol caps directory templates (on decode) and expanded URLs at MAX_URL_LEN = 8000 octets, RFC 9110 §4.1's recommended minimum URI support. Explicit exception to P20 (mimid-1wgh.5.34): P20 rejects per-field caps on protocol primitives (IdentifierUri, UTF8String); this caps HTTP request URLs, which are not wire primitives, and keeps a peer's directory from making us build URLs other HTTP stacks reject. Mark chose to keep it 2026-10-17.
